## Requirements (from spec deliverables + SIG ids)
1. AccountabilityEvent + LegalProceeding identity-only entities, §11.17–11.18 predicate surfaces
   (event_type; epistemic_status REQUIRED; docket/posture/parties) — SIG-ONTO-038. **[entities+enums exist from P01.1]**
2. epistemic_status required + preserved end to end: rejected if absent on write, carried verbatim
   upstream→ingestion→resolution→read, never flattened to "X happened" — SIG-ONTO-038.
3. Six-source-class linkage (OL-2E-AL-03): primary record; court record; agency statement; vendor
   statement; investigative article; advocacy analysis — class RECORDED on the evidence link — SIG-ONTO-039.
4. `accountability` connector: Atlas 5 artifacts (issue-record CSV, source-index CSV, GeoJSON, data
   dictionary, research archive) + Abuse Library + CourtListener (targeted-lookup only, §22.2);
   writes AccountabilityEvent, LegalProceeding, source-class-tagged evidence links; crosswalks upstream
   record categories (not adopted wholesale) — §23.8.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 epistemic_status required + preserved end to end (deterministic)
- [ ] AC2 an allegation never renders with a factual verb (agentic / render guard)
- [ ] AC3 incidents link to all six source classes with the class recorded; advocacy-only distinguishable from court-record (deterministic)
- [ ] AC4 phase-gate: CI green incl data-quality; new reqs have tests; ADR for deviations; traceability + risk register updated

## Out of scope (scope-creep guard)
- Policy, LegalInstrument, policy/config divergence → P13.2
- general curated-source-index-without-normalization capability (§10.9, SIG-EPIS-030) → P13.2
- public API / export surfaces over these entities → P14.1/P14.2
